title: Super Happy Magic Forest
description: While questing to protect the forest from weather spells, Blossom refuses to share the secret hiding place of her piece of the Amulet of Protection.

title: Grizzy and the Lemmings: World Tour
description: The Lemmings catch a grasshopper that can give you whatever your heart desires.

title: Duck and Frog
description: Frog is a wedding DJ and decides to liven things up with his favourite banging tunes.

title: Pokémon Horizons
description: Lacey challenges Ult with a special kind of training in the Terarium.

title: Winx Club - The Magic Is Back
description: Bloom faces Diaspro in the simulation room, unaware she secretly schemes with the Trix.

title: The Next Step: Cheer
description: Assistant Coach?! Kenzie adjusts to the new assistant coach, Denise. Ruby worries about the growing tensions between Levi and Ashton, and Layla feels pressure from Denise to perform.

title: Newsround
description: Topical news magazine for children.

title: Blue Peter: Diwali Celebrations and French Flying Adventure
description: Diwali Celebrations and French Flying Adventure. Shini and Hacker show viewers how to make decorations for Diwali.

title: Deadly 60
description: Giant Sea Lions and Chilean Bullfrog. Steve Backshall heads to Chile in search of giant frogs and feisty sea lions.

description: It's the end of an era on Gardeners' World as Monty approaches his final programme from Longmeadow. Carol Klein takes a deep dive into the scientific world of plants.

title: Naturewatch
description: The team investigates some of nature's biggest mysteries: where have all the acorns gone? Just how small is Britain's smallest bird? And do conkers really keep spiders away.

title: Grand Hotel
description: The lives of a diverse group of guests intersect during an eventful few days at a luxury Berlin hotel. Classic star-studded drama from MGM studios.

title: Ice Station Zebra
description: Tense Cold War action drama. A US submarine is dispatched to the frozen waters of the North Pole to recover a Soviet spy satellite.

title: Flog It!
description: In Norfolk, David Harper is excited by an early device for watching films, while David Fletcher and James Lewis reminisce about Rupert the Bear books and Dinky toys.

description: The second leg of the race takes the teams across the heart of Borneo to a modern metropolis on its eastern coast and their second checkpoint.

description: Action from the first round of the FA Cup as Altrincham of the National League take on League One Notts County.

title: 40 TV Theme Tunes at the BBC
description: A selection of 40 top title tracks which made such an impression on viewers that they made that difficult leap from TV schedules to the pop charts.

title: Greatest BBC Music Moments
description: From Pulp at the BBC Radio Theatre to Stormzy at Glastonbury, Dermot O'Leary, Jo Whiley and others bring their Greatest BBC Music Moments.

title: The Taste of Things
description: French romance set in 1889, focusing on the enduring bond between gourmet chef Dodin and his cook of 20 years, Eugénie. Dodin resolves to woo Eugénie by cooking for her.

title: This City Is Ours
description: Michael is forced to make an impossible decision in order to save the one he loves. Contains strong language and some violent scenes.

title: Celebrity Race Across the World
description: Four famous faces paired with a friend or a loved one race from Borneo to Australia.

title: This is BBC Two
description: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

description: Horticulturist Christine Walkden explores gardens and countryside from a hot-air balloon. In Mid Wales, Christine learns how to brace an ancient yew.

description: At Forest Green Rovers, known as the 'little club on the hill', Vick Hope discovers how a football team from a small Gloucestershire hamlet made it into the professional leagues.

title: BBC News
description: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

description: Dougie visits the annual autumn calf sale at the historic Newton Stewart mart, and Cammy investigates what the arrival of the bluetongue virus means for Scottish farmers.

title: Best of Weatherman Walking: Spectacular Southern Structures
description: Derek explores castles near Cardiff, the coast of Gower and the relics of the River Wye.

description: Four children, camping on an island in the Lake District, embark on a series of adventures that teach them the skills of survival and the value of friendship.

description: Eva heads to Domaine Dujac, home of the current most-wanted Burgundy wine. Burgundy's rich soil and savoir faire are parents to many culinary classics.

title: Bargain Hunt
description: Eric Knowles presents from Kingston in Surrey, with experts Thomas Forrester and Gary Pe.

title: Homes Under the Hammer
description: Featuring properties in Eccles-on-Sea, Islington and Sheffield.

title: MOTD Live: Cray Wanderers v Stockport County
description: Cray Wanderers of the Isthmian League face League One Stockport County in the first round of the FA Cup.

title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
description: How one of the greatest French arts is that of patisserie.

title: MOTD: FA Cup Highlights
description: Jason Mohammad presents highlights from the first round of the FA Cup. London's oldest club Cray Wanderers host Stockport County and non-league Stafford Rangers play Grimsby Town.

title: Scrum V: The Warm Up
description: Lauren Salter is joined by Shane Williams, Richie Rees and Tom Shanklin to break down Wales's opening autumn fixture against Japan.

title: Remembrance Sunday: The Cenotaph Highlights

description: Paul and Bob head to Shetland, the furthest place in the UK they have travelled to fish. It's wild, beautiful and full of surprises for both of them.

title: A Course Called Ireland
description: An icy Atlantic challenge awaits Bill, after seaside golfing craic with Chris O'Dowd. Contains strong language.

title: Later with Jools Holland
description: Jools welcomes Jamie T, Antony Szmierek, Violet Grohl, Emily Bear, Tia Gordon and Leo Sayer to the show. Contains some strong language.

title: Helmand: Tour of Duty
description: The stories of ten soldiers from the Welsh Guards on the front line of the Afghan war. Contains very strong language and upsetting scenes.
